note: Cases are small .orb programs checked against the installed compiler (`orb validate --json` reports the same codes, paths, messages and suggestions for ORB_BINDING_TRAIT_MISSING_NAME, ORB_BINDING_TRAIT_INVALID_FORMAT, ORB_BINDING_TRAIT_SELF_REFERENCE, ORB_BINDING_TRAIT_UNKNOWN, ORB_BINDING_TRAIT_OUTSIDE_RENDER_UI and ORB_BINDING_TRAIT_CYCLE), each with a paired control. Differences: the compiler walks the reference graph in hash order and reports whichever cycle it meets first; the atom walks it in declaration order, so the reported cycle can differ when an orbital has several.
